title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 28)
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari is part of the Debates in Creed series, focusing on the portrayal of the Prophet Muhammad in Umayyad and broader Islamic heritage.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Greatest Messenger in Islamic Heritage
